However, Saturn's presence in the 1st house may require you to focus on your responsibilities and personal growth before pursuing external opportunities.
data.scope: Your short-term scope appears to be focused on domestic or emotional matters, as indicated by the Sun's position in Cancer and Mercury's transit in the 4th house. You may need to navigate emotional conflicts or make decisions that affect your personal life.
data.study: Mercury's transit in the 4th house suggests that your learning or intellectual pursuits may be influenced by your domestic or emotional environment. You can use this as an opportunity to develop emotional intelligence or explore topics related to personal growth.
data.love: The presence of Venus in the 6th house may indicate that you're focusing on practical or daily aspects of relationships, rather than romantic or emotional connections. You may need to prioritize your daily routines and responsibilities to maintain a sense of balance in your relationships.
